deliberation: The proposal is exposed to authority laundering, semantic smuggling through allowed paths, packet replay, duplicate delivery, hold-versus-merge races, stale bases, spoofed check names, generator and dependency drift, confused-deputy credentials, and cross-repository partial execution. Calling a protected authority-schedule mutation an administrative projection cannot make it non-activating. Stage 1 and hostile shadow testing may proceed, but Stage 2 must remain disabled until these counterexamples become fail-closed executable controls and effective authority changes.
discharged_obligations: Attacked substitution, replay, concurrency, stale identity, path semantics, check identity, credentials, and partial failure.
Tested authority laundering across advice, authorization, merge, activation, production truth, and certification.
Tested whether append-only receipts prove correctness rather than merely record execution.
findings: An allowlisted projection can still change effective authority-bearing values.
At-least-once events can replay or concurrently consume one authorization.
Hold and check validation are vulnerable to time-of-check/time-of-use races.
Generators, actions, dependencies, runtime, and configuration are not packet-bound.
Check names alone can be spoofed and broad credentials create a confused deputy.
Cross-repository execution can leave a mixed state that consumers misread as complete.
conditions: Bind generator source, immutable actions, dependencies, runtime, configuration, packet, and expected output digest.
Prohibit automated mutations of authority schedules, office powers, protected workflows, credentials, AETHER authority, and MATHCERT dispositions absent a later exact grant.
Use atomic per-edge consumption and merge-time revalidation against holds, reviews, authority, rulesets, exact base, and head.
Use narrowly scoped short-lived repository and branch credentials inaccessible to pull-request code.
Treat cross-repository execution as a fail-closed saga with incomplete states visible and compensation separately authorized.
Add adversarial tests for every enumerated attack before enablement.
residual_uncertainty: No implementation or adversarial suite exists yet.
Downstream consumers of intermediate authority records have not been inventoried.
